translations.web: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.
translations.bsb: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you shall not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
translations.kjv: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come
